description: Sets how many reminder emails a webinar sends and which preset decides their timing: factory, all before the start, all after the start, or the mixed 4 plus 1 preset. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Every registrant is affected from the next send on; the wording of a single email is not touched, only which of them go out and when. Needs `session_id` and `webinar_id` from wi_list_webinars. Use `count` for how many reminders are active (0 to 5) and `frame` for the preset. For the text of one email use wi_change_webinar_email, for the whole journey wi_check_participant_journey.

count.description: How many reminder emails are active, 0 to 5. 0 switches them all off.

frame.description: factory keeps the default spacing, all_before sends every reminder before the start, all_after sends them after it, mixed_4_1 sends four before and one after.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_reminders
title: Switch the reminder emails on or off
